flags: The company entered a new $1.0 billion senior secured credit facility that replaced its existing credit agreement, and repaid $200.0 million of obligations under the old agreement the same day.
The company closed its acquisition of Marigold's Enterprise Business. The 10-K ties the rise in acquisition-related expenses to this deal.
no_value_reason: no valuation route for this kind of company yet (real estate, pre-profit biotech)

business_model.claim: Zeta sells an AI-powered cloud marketing platform, the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), to enterprises. It combines consumer intelligence data with marketing automation software.
quotes: Zeta is a leading AI-powered omnichannel data-driven cloud platform that provides enterprises with consumer intelligence and marketing automation software.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K Item 1 and Item 7
business_model.claim: The product set has three core products (ESP messaging, CDP+ data management and DSP media activation), plus the Zeta Answers intelligence suite. Customers can buy them individually or in combination.
quotes: Our customers can purchase our products individually or in combination based on their evolving needs.

business_model.claim: Revenue comes from subscription fees, volume-based utilization fees and professional-services fees. In the nine months to September 30, 2026, 72% came from direct platforms and 28% from integrated platforms, versus 75% and 25% a year earlier.
quotes: Our revenue primarily arises from use of our technology platform via subscription fees, volume-based utilization fees and fees for professional services.

For the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, we derived 72% and 75% of our revenues from direct platforms, respectively, and 28% and 25% of our revenues from integrated platforms, respectively.

business_model.basis: stated in both the 10-K and the 10-Q MD&A. No product or segment revenue split is given in the visible text.
business_model.claim: Zeta reports a single reportable segment. The chief operating decision maker is the CEO.
quotes: We operate as a single reportable segment

business_model.claim: Customers are enterprises. Super-scaled customers (at least $1.0 million of revenue in the trailing twelve months) were 184 at year-end 2025 and made up 87% of 2025 revenue, up from 148 and 84% in 2024.
quotes: As of December 31, 2025, we had 184 super-scaled customers representing 87% of total revenue in 2025, compared to 148 super-scaled customers as of December 31, 2024, representing 84% of total revenue in 2024.

business_model.claim: Customer concentration is notable. In 2025 one customer exceeded 10% of revenue, and customers can change spend or leave on limited notice.
quotes: In 2025, our top ten customers accounted for more than one-third of our total revenue, and one customer accounted for more than 10% of our total revenue.
Such agreements allow our customers to change the amount of spend through our platform or terminate our services with limited notice.

business_model.claim: Revenue growth is driven by higher usage and ARPU among existing customers plus new customers and acquisitions. In 2025, $190.9 million of the revenue increase came from existing customers and $108.0 million from new customers, including approximately $84.2 million from acquisitions.
quotes: The increase in revenues is attributable to incremental revenues of $108.0 million from new customers (including approximately $84.2 million from acquisitions) and $190.9 million from existing customers.
Our annual NRR rate was 128.0% and 113.6% for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-Q income statement and the earnings release. The acquisition closing date comes from the 10-K MD&A and is not cited here.
business_model.claim: Third-quarter 2026 revenue was 492,658 versus 337,169 a year earlier (table in thousands of USD). Management cites growth of 46%, or 30% excluding Marigold and political candidate revenue, so acquisition revenue contributes materially.
quotes: Delivered revenue of $493 million for the third quarter, an increase of 46% Y/Y or 30% Y/Y excluding Marigold and political candidate revenue, an acceleration from 28% growth excluding Marigold last quarter.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-Q MD&A and the earnings release
business_model.claim: Customer metrics rose in the third quarter of 2026. Super-scaled customers increased 18% to 212 from 180, and quarterly super-scaled ARPU rose 22% to $2.0 million.
quotes: Super-scaled customers increased 18% to 212 as of September 30, 2026, compared to 180 as of September 30, 2025, primarily due to higher usage of our platform among our customers and new additions to our super-scaled customer base.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K MD&A and the 10-Q income statement
business_model.claim: The largest cost is cost of revenues, mainly media and marketing fees paid to third-party publishers and partners. These rise with revenue. In 2025, $89.9 million of the cost increase was incremental media costs.
quotes: Cost of revenues excludes depreciation and amortization and consists primarily of media and marketing costs and certain employee-related costs.
This increase was primarily driven by $89.9 million of incremental media costs related to incremental revenues, higher technology expenses of $22.8 million and employee-related costs of $1.3 million.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K and in the 10-Q statements
business_model.claim: People costs, much of it stock-based compensation, are the main operating cost beyond media. For the nine months to September 30, 2026, selling and marketing was 315,884, R&D was 128,724 and stock-based compensation was 155,125 (tables in thousands of USD).
quotes: Selling and marketing expenses primarily consist of employee-related costs, including salaries, bonuses, employee benefits costs, stock-based compensation and commission costs for our sales and marketing personnel.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-Q income statement and the earnings release
business_model.claim: Revenue growth has outpaced costs recently, turning the business GAAP-profitable. Nine-month 2026 operating income was 44,033 and net income 33,199, versus operating loss (12,466) and net loss (38,048) a year earlier (table in thousands of USD).
quotes: Achieved positive GAAP net income of $38 million, and diluted GAAP earnings per share of $0.14 for the third quarter.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K MD&A. The political figure is from the earnings release reconciliation table.
business_model.claim: Revenue is seasonal and cyclical. Activity is higher in the fourth quarter than the first, and political spending lifts revenue in election years. The third quarter of 2026 included $7.4 million of political candidate revenue (table in millions).
quotes: Historically, marketing activity is higher in the fourth quarter of the calendar year to coincide with the holiday shopping season as compared to the first quarter.

business_model.basis: stated in the 8-K and the 10-Q cash flow statement
